description: First 50 seeds only - testing 'starting well' quality

scoring_criteria.9: Perfect native speech in both languages
scoring_criteria.1-2: Marginal, no one would say this

phrases.english: Because I do not like to take too much time to meet people.
phrases.other: 因为我不喜欢花太多时间见人。
phrases.notes: Both languages natural. Chinese correctly uses 花时间 (spend time). Minor: English 'do not' slightly formal vs 'don't'.

phrases.english: I cannot speak a little Chinese with someone else now.
phrases.other: 我现在不能和别人说一点中文。
phrases.notes: English is awkward - 'speak a little Chinese' with 'cannot' doesn't work semantically. You can't 'not speak a little'. Chinese is grammatically correct but mirrors the awkward meaning.

phrases.english: He wants to come back with everyone else later on.
phrases.other: 他想以后和别人一起回来。
phrases.notes: Both natural. Chinese word order good with time (以后) appropriately placed. 和别人一起 is correct collocation.

phrases.english: Or if he doesn't want to finish as quickly as possible.
phrases.other: 或者如果他不想尽快完成。
phrases.notes: Both acceptable. English is a fragment (starts with 'Or if') but could be part of conversation. Chinese is correct.

phrases.english: as often as possible
phrases.other: 尽量多
phrases.notes: Short phrase, both natural. 尽量多 captures the meaning well. Could also be 尽可能多 but 尽量多 is more conversational.

phrases.english: He wants us to quickly find out his meaning this evening.
phrases.other: 他想让我们今天晚上快点找出他的意思。
phrases.notes: English 'find out his meaning' is slightly odd (usually 'understand what he means'). Chinese is grammatical but mirrors the awkwardness.

phrases.english: I am not sure if I can practice speaking Chinese today.
phrases.other: 我不确定我今天能不能练习说中文。
phrases.notes: Both very natural. Chinese 能不能 structure for embedded yes/no question is perfect. Word order correct.

phrases.english: Are you going to help me before I have to go this evening?
phrases.other: 你会在我今天晚上要走之前帮我吗？
phrases.notes: Both natural. Chinese temporal clause structure (在...之前) is correct. Slightly complex but well-formed.

phrases.english: Let us practice speaking Chinese at six o'clock this evening.
phrases.other: 让我们今天晚上六点练习说中文。
phrases.notes: Both natural. Chinese time placement (今天晚上六点) before verb is correct. 让我们 for 'let us' is perfect.

phrases.english: I am not sure if I can finish explaining my meaning now.
phrases.other: 我不确定我现在能不能解释完我的意思。
phrases.notes: Both functional. Chinese uses resultative complement 解释完 correctly. 'Finish explaining my meaning' slightly textbookish in English.

phrases.english: He does not want to stop talking, he wants to find out the answer.
phrases.other: 他不想停止说话，他想找出答案。
phrases.notes: Both natural. Chinese uses 停止说话 which is correct, though 不想停 alone is also common. Good parallel structure.

phrases.english: Soon she is going to help me remember his name easily.
phrases.other: 很快她要帮我容易记住他的名字了。
phrases.notes: Chinese word order issue: 容易 (easily) should come before 帮 or use 容易地, not between 帮我 and 记住. Should be 很快她要帮我容易地记住... or restructure.

phrases.english: I am not sure if I can speak Chinese with you today.
phrases.other: 我不确定我今天能不能和你说中文。
phrases.notes: Both very natural. Word order perfect in Chinese with time (今天) before manner/companion (和你).

phrases.english: How to practice talking with someone else?
phrases.other: 怎么和别人练习说话?
phrases.notes: Both functional. English fragment but acceptable as topic/question. Chinese word order natural.

phrases.english: Because I want to start meeting more people this evening.
phrases.other: 因为我想今天晚上开始见多人。
phrases.notes: Chinese error: 见多人 is wrong. Should be 见更多的人 or 多见人. Missing 更 and classifier/的 structure.

phrases.english: Because she wants to find out his name before we meet.
phrases.other: 因为她想在我们见面之前找出他的名字。
phrases.notes: Both very natural. Chinese temporal clause 在...之前 correctly positioned.

phrases.english: And we will practice speaking Chinese all day together with him.
phrases.other: 而且我们会整天和他一起练习说中文。
phrases.notes: Both natural. Chinese word order perfect: time (整天) + companion (和他一起) + verb.

phrases.english: But we do not want to stop talking all day with everyone.
phrases.other: 但是我们不想整天停止和别人说话。
phrases.notes: Semantically odd in both languages - 'stop talking all day' is contradictory. The meaning is unclear.

phrases.english: Because I am not going to easily learn her name this evening.
phrases.other: 因为我今天晚上不会容易学她的名字。
phrases.notes: Chinese error: 容易 placement wrong - should be 容易地学 or use 不容易学. Current structure is ungrammatical.

phrases.english: I want you to meet with her tomorrow evening and speak Chinese.
phrases.other: 我想让你明天晚上和她见面说中文。
phrases.notes: Both natural. Chinese causative 让 structure perfect. Good serial verb construction.

phrases.english: I want to try as hard as I can to speak Chinese today.
phrases.other: 我今天想尽量努力地说中文。
phrases.notes: Both natural. Chinese uses 尽量努力地 appropriately, though 尽力 alone would also work.

phrases.english: I am not sure if I can speak Chinese after I finish today.
phrases.other: 我不确定今天以后我能不能说中文。
phrases.notes: English slightly ambiguous (finish what?). Chinese 今天以后 means 'after today' not 'after I finish today'. Minor mismatch.

phrases.english: I want to try hard to explain my meaning in Chinese with you.
phrases.other: 我想努力试着用中文和你解释我的意思。
phrases.notes: Both functional. Chinese 努力试着 is slightly redundant but acceptable. Word order is correct.

phrases.english: Why is he not going to start talking more with us?
phrases.other: 他为什么不会开始和我们多说话？
phrases.notes: Both natural. Chinese question structure correct with 为什么. Word order good.

phrases.english: I am not sure if I can remember the whole sentence now.
phrases.other: 我不确定我现在能不能记住整个句子。
phrases.notes: Both very natural. Classifier 个 with 整 is correct for 句子.

phrases.english: I want to learn how to speak Chinese with you now.
phrases.other: 我现在想学怎么和你说中文。
phrases.notes: Both very natural. Chinese embedded question with 怎么 is perfect.

phrases.english: I am trying hard to learn Chinese, and it will happen.
phrases.other: 我在努力试着学中文，而且会发生。
phrases.notes: English 'it will happen' is vague but passable. Chinese 会发生 (will happen) doesn't work - 发生 is for events, not achievement of goals. Should be 会成功 or 会做到.

phrases.english: Soon she will start speaking Chinese more with everyone else.
phrases.other: 很快她会开始和别人多说中文。
phrases.notes: Both natural. Chinese word order good with 多 before verb.

phrases.english: I want to try to explain my meaning after you finish speaking.
phrases.other: 我想在你说完以后试着解释我的意思。
phrases.notes: Both natural. Chinese temporal clause 在...以后 with resultative 说完 is perfect.

phrases.english: She will stop talking at six o'clock and come back tomorrow.
phrases.other: 她会六点停止说话，明天回来。
phrases.notes: Both functional. Chinese slightly better with 在六点 but acceptable without.

phrases.english: I am trying to remember my Chinese word as often as possible.
phrases.other: 我在试着尽量多记住我的中文词。
phrases.notes: English 'my Chinese word' (singular) is odd - should be 'words'. Chinese is fine grammatically.

phrases.english: At six o'clock tomorrow she will find out what the answer is.
phrases.other: 明天六点她会找出答案是什么。
phrases.notes: Both natural. Chinese embedded question 答案是什么 works well.

phrases.english: We do not want to guess, we want to find out the answer.
phrases.other: 我们不想猜，我们想找出答案。
phrases.notes: Both very natural. Good parallel structure in both languages.

phrases.english: Because she is nearly ready to help us before we meet.
phrases.other: 因为她快要在我们见面之前帮我们。
phrases.notes: Chinese 快要 (about to) with 之前 clause creates awkward construction. 快要帮我们了 would be better, or restructure the temporal relationship.

phrases.english: Soon she will be nearly ready to go and help everyone.
phrases.other: 很快她快要走帮别人了。
phrases.notes: Chinese is incomplete - missing connector between 走 and 帮. Should be 走去帮 or 走，帮. Also 很快...快要 is redundant.

phrases.english: But I want you to stop talking and try to remember the sentence.
phrases.other: 但是我想让你停止说话，试着记住句子。
phrases.notes: Both natural. Chinese causative and serial verb structure is correct.

phrases.english: But we do not like taking too much time in order to meet.
phrases.other: 但是我们不喜欢花太多时间来见面。
phrases.notes: Both natural. Chinese 来 for purpose is correct usage.

phrases.english: Because he feels okay now compared to last night.
phrases.other: 因为他现在感觉比昨天晚上还可以。
phrases.notes: Chinese 还可以 with 比 is unusual - typically 比...好 or 比...更好. 还 here is ambiguous.

phrases.english: But we do not think it is useful to go before we start talking.
phrases.other: 但是我们不感觉在我们开始说话之前走是有用的。
phrases.notes: Chinese uses 感觉 (feel) instead of 觉得/认为 (think). Also sentence structure is awkward - 走是有用的 as subject is unnatural.

phrases.english: But I do not want to stop talking with her at six o'clock.
phrases.other: 但是我不想六点停止和她说话。
phrases.notes: Both natural. Chinese word order acceptable with time before verb phrase.

phrases.english: Why are we learning her answer before we meet at six?
phrases.other: 我们为什么在六点见面学她的答案？
phrases.notes: Chinese missing 之前 - currently reads as 'at 6 o'clock when meeting'. Should be 在六点见面之前.

phrases.english: Because she does not want to take too much to help us.
phrases.other: 因为她不想花太多帮我们。
phrases.notes: English incomplete - 'take too much' what? Time? Chinese similarly incomplete - 花太多 (spend too much) needs object (时间/钱).

phrases.english: Because we do not want to stop talking with everyone else.
phrases.other: 因为我们不想停止和别人说话。
phrases.notes: Both natural. Good basic sentence structure.

phrases.english: I want to try to say a sentence in Chinese with you today.
phrases.other: 我今天想试着和你用中文说一个句子。
phrases.notes: Both natural. Chinese uses correct measure word 个 for 句子. Good word order.

phrases.english: think carefully
phrases.other: 仔细想
phrases.notes: Both perfect. Simple, natural expression in both languages.

phrases.english: Because I don't want to finish as quickly as possible.
phrases.other: 因为我不想尽快完成。
phrases.notes: Both natural. Chinese 尽快 perfect for 'as quickly as possible'.

phrases.english: And we will find out the answer at six o'clock this evening.
phrases.other: 而且我们会今天晚上六点找出答案。
phrases.notes: Both functional. Chinese time phrase position is acceptable, though 在今天晚上六点 would be more formal.

phrases.english: I am trying to learn a little more Chinese as often as possible.
phrases.other: 我在试着尽量多学一点中文。
phrases.notes: Both natural. Chinese captures meaning well with 尽量多学一点.

phrases.english: speak with someone else
phrases.other: 和别人说
phrases.notes: Both natural fragments. Chinese word order correct.

phrases.english: But he does not want to stop quickly, he wants to speak more.
phrases.other: 但是他不想快点停止，他想说。
phrases.notes: Chinese incomplete - 他想说 (he wants to speak) missing 更多/多说. Should mirror 'speak more' properly.

phrases_below_5.english: I cannot speak a little Chinese with someone else now.
phrases_below_5.other: 我现在不能和别人说一点中文。
phrases_below_5.issue: Semantically awkward - 'cannot speak a little' doesn't work in English

phrases_below_5.other: 因为我想今天晚上开始见多人。
phrases_below_5.issue: Chinese error: 见多人 wrong, should be 见更多的人

phrases_below_5.english: Because I am not going to easily learn her name this evening.
phrases_below_5.other: 因为我今天晚上不会容易学她的名字。
phrases_below_5.issue: Chinese adverb placement error - 容易 positioned incorrectly

phrases_below_5.other: 很快她快要走帮别人了。
phrases_below_5.issue: Chinese missing connector between verbs, redundant 很快...快要

phrases_below_5.english: But we do not think it is useful to go before we start talking.
phrases_below_5.other: 但是我们不感觉在我们开始说话之前走是有用的。
phrases_below_5.issue: Chinese uses 感觉 instead of 觉得, awkward subject structure

phrases_below_5.english: I am trying hard to learn Chinese, and it will happen.
phrases_below_5.other: 我在努力试着学中文，而且会发生。
phrases_below_5.issue: Chinese 会发生 (will happen) doesn't work for goals/achievements

phrases_below_5.english: Because she does not want to take too much to help us.
phrases_below_5.other: 因为她不想花太多帮我们。
phrases_below_5.issue: Both languages incomplete - 'take too much' and 花太多 missing object

worst_3_phrases.english: I am trying hard to learn Chinese, and it will happen.
worst_3_phrases.other: 我在努力试着学中文，而且会发生。
worst_3_phrases.reason: Critical Chinese error: 发生 (happen) is for events occurring, not for goals being achieved. A native speaker would never say 会发生 in this context. Should use 会成功 (will succeed) or 会做到 (will achieve it).

worst_3_phrases.english: Because she does not want to take too much to help us.
worst_3_phrases.other: 因为她不想花太多帮我们。
worst_3_phrases.reason: Both languages are incomplete fragments. English 'take too much' needs an object (time? effort?). Chinese 花太多 similarly needs 时间 or 钱 as object. Neither sentence is functional as written.

worst_3_phrases.english: I cannot speak a little Chinese with someone else now.
worst_3_phrases.other: 我现在不能和别人说一点中文。
worst_3_phrases.reason: Semantic contradiction in English - you cannot 'not speak a little'. The negation with 'a little' creates logical nonsense. Chinese mirrors this awkwardness.

key_issues_identified: Adverb placement errors in Chinese (容易, 多)
Semantic contradictions with quantity words and negation
Missing measure words or structural elements
summary.overall_assessment: Round 3 shows decent quality overall (6.58 average) with 38% scoring 8+ (strong/excellent). However, 14% score below 5 (7 phrases), indicating systematic issues with Chinese adverb placement, incomplete structures, and occasional semantic mismatches. The worst issues involve verb collocations (发生) and missing grammatical elements. Recommend reviewing adverb positioning rules and ensuring all transitive verbs have their required objects.
